description: Gen Z daily life topics for mood recording app — 6 modules, 20 topics each
source: Based on Reddit r/GenZ, TikTok trends, Fortune/Medium research reports 2024-2026

modules.label: Work
modules.tagline: What's draining you at work today?

topics.opening_question: Today at work, was there a moment you just wanted to shut everything down?
topics.resonance: 83% of Gen Z frontline workers report burnout — highest of any group

topics.opening_question: Did someone take credit for your work, or did what you did just go completely unnoticed?
topics.resonance: Top Gen Z complaint — being seen and recognized matters more than salary

topics.opening_question: Did your boss say or do something today that made you question everything?
topics.resonance: Gen Z leaves toxic workplaces — they don't tolerate it like previous generations

topics.opening_question: After clocking out, did your brain actually clock out — or was it still spinning?
topics.resonance: 25% of Gen Z choose work-life balance over salary when picking jobs

topics.topic: Fear of being laid off / AI replacing me
topics.opening_question: Did you have a moment today where you wondered if your job is actually safe?
topics.resonance: 47% of Gen Z cite job security as top financial fear; 13% drop in entry-level jobs since AI adoption

topics.opening_question: Did you end up handling something today that wasn't even your responsibility?
topics.resonance: Common Reddit thread: 'I'm doing 3 people's jobs for 1 person's pay'

topics.opening_question: How much of yourself did you actually show up with today — or were you just going through the motions?
topics.resonance: Gen Z coined quiet quitting — doing exactly what you're paid for, nothing more

topics.opening_question: Was there a meeting today that could have been an email — or honestly, nothing at all?
topics.resonance: Top Gen Z workplace frustration, heavily discussed on Reddit r/antiwork

topics.opening_question: Did you have a moment today where you felt like everyone around you was more capable?
topics.resonance: Extremely common among Gen Z entering their first professional roles

topics.opening_question: Was there something you did today that you're quietly proud of — even if no one noticed?
topics.resonance: Counterbalance prompt — important to capture positive moments too

topics.opening_question: Was there someone at work today whose energy just... got to you?
topics.resonance: 37% of Gen Z cite 'difficult people' as top burnout cause

topics.opening_question: Did you think today about how much you're doing versus how much you're actually getting paid?
topics.resonance: Gen Z is the most vocal generation about pay transparency and salary fairness

topics.opening_question: Did the whole where-you-work situation create any friction today?
topics.resonance: Return-to-office mandates are a major Gen Z dealbreaker — heavily discussed on Reddit

topics.opening_question: Was there something on your to-do list today that you kept moving to tomorrow?
topics.resonance: Task avoidance tied to anxiety and feeling overwhelmed, not laziness

topics.opening_question: Did you say something today that no one responded to — or someone else got credit for it later?
topics.resonance: Gen Z feels unheard in professional settings — major source of frustration

topics.opening_question: Did you have a moment today where you wondered if this is even what you want to be doing?
topics.resonance: Only 4% of Gen Z want to become executives — career meaning matters more than climbing

topics.opening_question: Did you do exactly what you were told today — knowing it would backfire — just to prove a point?
topics.resonance: TikTok trend with millions of views — Gen Z's way of surviving toxic workplaces

topics.opening_question: Did anyone say something positive about your work today — even something small?
topics.resonance: Gen Z is motivated by recognition — catching these moments matters

topics.opening_question: Is there a deadline hanging over you right now that you're trying not to think about?
topics.resonance: 35% of Gen Z cite fast pace and tight deadlines as top burnout causes

topics.opening_question: Did you think about quitting today — even just for a second?
topics.resonance: Over a third of Gen Z would quit if their job negatively impacts their mental health

modules.label: School
modules.tagline: What's been heavy in school lately?

topics.opening_question: Was there a moment today in class or while studying when your brain just... refused to cooperate?
topics.resonance: Attention issues are a top Gen Z academic complaint — linked to phone habits and anxiety

topics.opening_question: Is there a due date or exam that's been living in the back of your head that you're not ready to face?
topics.resonance: Academic procrastination driven by anxiety, not laziness — massive Reddit topic

topics.opening_question: Did it feel today like everyone around you has it figured out except you?
topics.resonance: Academic comparison anxiety spikes on social media — very common Gen Z experience

topics.topic: Why am I even studying this
topics.opening_question: Did you have a moment today where you genuinely couldn't see the point of what you were learning?
topics.resonance: Gen Z questions ROI on education more than any previous generation

topics.opening_question: Did the thought of your student loans cross your mind today?
topics.resonance: Average Gen Z student carries $32,000 in loans — a constant background anxiety

topics.opening_question: Did you end up doing the majority of the work in a group situation today?
topics.resonance: Universal student frustration — doing the work while others coast

topics.opening_question: Did a professor or teacher say something today that rubbed you the wrong way?
topics.resonance: Gen Z pushes back on authority more openly than previous generations

topics.opening_question: How much mental space did grades take up for you today?
topics.resonance: Academic performance anxiety is one of Gen Z's top daily stressors

topics.opening_question: Did you spend most of today kind of on your own — by choice or not by choice?
topics.resonance: Post-pandemic Gen Z struggled to rebuild social connections on campus

topics.topic: What do I even want to do after this
topics.opening_question: Did the 'what's next after school' question come up for you today — even quietly?
topics.resonance: 57% of Gen Z college students report career-related anxiety as their top stressor

topics.topic: AI in school — cheating or tool
topics.opening_question: Did you use AI for schoolwork today — or think about whether you should?
topics.resonance: Massive ethical tension Gen Z navigates daily — top Reddit education topic

topics.opening_question: Was there a concept or moment today where things suddenly made sense?
topics.resonance: Capturing positive academic moments to balance negativity bias

topics.opening_question: Did money stuff make it hard to focus on school today?
topics.resonance: 8 in 10 college students say financial struggles harm their mental health

topics.topic: Class I'm close to giving up on
topics.opening_question: Is there a class right now where you're running low on the will to keep going?
topics.resonance: 42 million students have left school — financial and mental health reasons top the list

topics.opening_question: Did you catch yourself comparing where you are to where someone else in your class seems to be?
topics.resonance: Comparison culture intensified by LinkedIn and social media oversharing

topics.opening_question: Was there a moment today where you had something to say but held back?
topics.resonance: Gen Z has higher rates of social anxiety in academic settings

topics.opening_question: Did you sacrifice sleep for school recently — and is it catching up with you?
topics.resonance: Sleep deprivation normalized in academic culture but devastating for mental health

topics.opening_question: Did the job or internship search come up today — and how did that feel?
topics.resonance: 13% drop in entry-level jobs due to AI — Gen Z entering a harder market than expected

topics.opening_question: Have your friendships changed since this semester started — drifted, shifted, or surprised you?
topics.resonance: College transitions disrupt friend groups — very common source of quiet sadness

topics.opening_question: Did you do one small thing today related to school that you can feel okay about?
topics.resonance: Capturing micro-progress is key to sustaining motivation during hard semesters

modules.label: Romance / Dating
modules.tagline: What's going on with your love life?

topics.opening_question: Are you in something that feels like more than nothing but less than a relationship — and it's messing with your head?
topics.resonance: 50% of 18-34 year olds have been in a situationship — defining Gen Z romance

topics.opening_question: Did someone just... disappear on you recently without explanation?
topics.resonance: 84% of Gen Z have been ghosted — a defining emotional wound of the generation

topics.topic: Something I wanted to say but didn't
topics.opening_question: Was there something you wanted to say to someone today — but you held it in?
topics.resonance: 57% of Gen Z won't confess feelings out of fear of rejection — massive Hinge stat

topics.opening_question: Is there someone whose signals are so mixed you can't tell what's real?
topics.resonance: Top dating complaint on TikTok and Reddit — 'what are we' is the Gen Z anthem

topics.opening_question: Did swiping or matching feel more draining than exciting today?
topics.resonance: 37% of singles under 30 say they're not interested in dating anymore — app burnout is real

topics.topic: Thinking about someone who's not thinking about me
topics.opening_question: Is there someone you keep coming back to in your head who probably isn't doing the same?
topics.resonance: A universally relatable Gen Z experience, heavily processed on TikTok and Reddit

topics.opening_question: Is there something in your current relationship that's making you feel uneasy — even if it's hard to explain?
topics.resonance: Gen Z prioritizes emotional safety and 'soft life' in relationships over intensity

topics.topic: Feeling like I give more than I get
topics.opening_question: In this connection, does it feel like the effort is balanced — or is it landing mostly on you?
topics.resonance: Effort imbalance is the most common reason Gen Z ends relationships

topics.opening_question: Is there something small that happened recently with someone that you keep going back to?
topics.resonance: Micro-details dominate Gen Z romantic anxiety — the small things carry big weight

topics.topic: Gave up on dating for now
topics.opening_question: Have you been stepping back from the whole dating thing — and how does that actually feel?
topics.resonance: 37% of Gen Z singles under 30 say they're not interested in dating right now

topics.opening_question: Are you still working through something that ended — even if it was a while ago?
topics.resonance: Gen Z breakups are amplified by social media reminders and mutual-following culture

topics.topic: Someone from the past showed up
topics.opening_question: Did someone you used to have something with resurface in some way today — in person, online, or in your mind?
topics.resonance: Instagram and TikTok make 'out of sight out of mind' nearly impossible

topics.opening_question: Did you catch yourself looking at someone else's relationship and feeling something about yours?
topics.resonance: Relationship content on social media creates unrealistic benchmarks for Gen Z

topics.topic: Good moment with someone I like
topics.opening_question: Was there a good moment with someone today — something that made you smile after?
topics.resonance: Micro-romance moments matter to Gen Z — the small gestures, not grand gestures

topics.opening_question: Is there someone you like but you're holding back because you don't want to get hurt?
topics.resonance: Gen Z is the most risk-averse generation in love — prospect theory drives dating avoidance

topics.opening_question: Is there someone who gives you just enough attention to keep you around, but never commits?
topics.resonance: Breadcrumbing is one of the most Googled Gen Z dating terms — a very real pain point

topics.opening_question: Are there any feelings around physical closeness — or lack of it — that have been on your mind?
topics.resonance: Gen Z is more openly sex-positive but also navigating intimacy anxiety at higher rates

topics.topic: Wondering if they're the right person
topics.opening_question: Have you had doubts lately about whether the person you're with is actually right for you long-term?
topics.resonance: Gen Z does 'future-proofing' — evaluating long-term compatibility early and seriously

topics.opening_question: Did something happen today that made a feeling of jealousy or insecurity come up — even a little?
topics.resonance: Attachment anxiety is highly prevalent in Gen Z — social media amplifies it

topics.topic: Wanting love but scared of it
topics.opening_question: Do you find yourself wanting a real connection but also kind of terrified of what that means?
topics.resonance: Bell hooks quote resonates with Gen Z: 'Young people are cynical about love'

modules.label: Friends / Family
modules.tagline: How are the people around you?

topics.opening_question: Is there a friendship that's been quietly slipping — fewer texts, fewer plans, just less?
topics.resonance: Gen Z describes 'friend fade' as one of the loneliest quiet experiences of adulthood

topics.topic: Feeling like a burden to friends
topics.opening_question: Did you hold back from reaching out to someone today because you didn't want to be too much?
topics.resonance: Very common Reddit post theme in r/GenZ and r/mentalhealth — the 'don't want to burden them' loop

topics.opening_question: Is there something someone said to you recently that you're still turning over in your head?
topics.resonance: Gen Z processes social interactions intensely — replaying is a common anxious habit

topics.topic: Family pressure about my life choices
topics.opening_question: Did family say anything recently about what you're doing — or not doing — with your life?
topics.resonance: Generational value clashes between Gen Z and parents are a top Reddit discussion topic

topics.topic: Feeling like the invisible one in the group
topics.opening_question: Did you feel kind of like a background character in your own friend group today?
topics.resonance: 'Transparent person' is Gen Z's phrase for feeling unseen in social groups

topics.opening_question: Is there something going on in your life right now that you're not telling your family about?
topics.resonance: Gen Z frequently hides struggles from parents to avoid worry or judgment

topics.topic: Friend who only comes to me when they need something
topics.opening_question: Is there someone in your life who only shows up when they need something from you?
topics.resonance: Gen Z is setting friendship boundaries — recognizing one-sided dynamics more clearly

topics.opening_question: Did you spend time with people today but still feel kind of alone?
topics.resonance: 73% of Gen Z feel lonely — often happening even in social settings

topics.opening_question: Did you have a moment today where you genuinely felt connected to someone — even briefly?
topics.resonance: 66% of Gen Z are looking for real belonging, not just social interaction

topics.topic: Family conflict or tension at home
topics.opening_question: Was there any friction at home today — said or unsaid?
topics.resonance: Many Gen Z still live with or near family — home tension directly affects daily wellbeing

topics.topic: Someone I miss but haven't reached out to
topics.opening_question: Is there someone you've been thinking about but haven't contacted — what's stopping you?
topics.resonance: The 'I should text them' loop that never resolves is a very Gen Z experience

topics.opening_question: Are you the person in your circle that everyone leans on — and is that getting heavy?
topics.resonance: Many Gen Z identify as the 'therapist friend' — a role that breeds quiet resentment

topics.opening_question: Did you show up for someone today — check in, listen, or just be there?
topics.resonance: Recognizing acts of care helps Gen Z see their own capacity for connection

topics.opening_question: Did someone come through for you recently in a way you didn't expect?
topics.resonance: Unexpected kindness is powerful for Gen Z who have low trust baselines in friendships

topics.opening_question: Did family comparison come up today — either said out loud or just felt?
topics.resonance: Family comparisons are a silent wound for many Gen Z, rarely verbalized

topics.topic: Skipping social plans to stay in
topics.opening_question: Did you cancel on or avoid a social thing today — and how did that feel?
topics.resonance: Gen Z cancels plans at high rates due to anxiety and financial constraints

topics.topic: Friendship boundary I need to set
topics.opening_question: Is there a dynamic with a friend that you know isn't working for you, but you haven't said anything yet?
topics.resonance: Gen Z values boundaries but struggles to implement them in friendships

topics.topic: Family member going through something hard
topics.opening_question: Is there someone in your family dealing with something difficult right now, and it's weighing on you too?
topics.resonance: Gen Z carries family weight silently — especially in immigrant or struggling households

topics.opening_question: Is there someone new in your life that you've been getting closer to — and how does that feel?
topics.resonance: New social bonds are meaningful for a generation that struggles with deep connection

topics.topic: Social media made me feel left out
topics.opening_question: Did you see something on social media today that made you feel like you were missing out?
topics.resonance: FOMO through Instagram and Snapchat stories is a daily micro-wound for Gen Z

modules.label: Money / Future
modules.tagline: What's the money or future stress today?

topics.opening_question: Did financial stress creep in when you were trying to rest or wind down?
topics.resonance: 70% of Gen Z say financial anxiety disrupts their sleep — highest of any generation

topics.topic: Ran out of money before end of month
topics.opening_question: Is money feeling tight right now — like the month is longer than the paycheck?
topics.resonance: 63% of Gen Z report running out of money before the end of the month

topics.topic: Can't afford to buy a home
topics.opening_question: Did the thought of ever owning a home — or just having stable housing — feel out of reach today?
topics.resonance: Housing costs are Gen Z's second biggest financial stressor after job security

topics.opening_question: Did you buy something today that felt like either a treat or a mistake — or both?
topics.resonance: 'Treatonomics' — small splurges as coping — is a documented Gen Z financial behavior

topics.opening_question: Did you see someone's lifestyle on social media today and feel like you're falling behind financially?
topics.resonance: Financial comparison via TikTok and Instagram is a key Gen Z anxiety trigger

topics.topic: Don't know what career path to take
topics.opening_question: Did 'what am I actually going to do with my life' cross your mind today?
topics.resonance: Nearly 3 in 5 Gen Z lack a sense of purpose — Harvard study 2022

topics.opening_question: Did a thought about AI and job security come up today — even briefly?
topics.resonance: 41% of Gen Z are anxious about AI's impact on their careers — Gallup-Walton 2025

topics.opening_question: Does it feel like you're always one unexpected expense away from a crisis?
topics.resonance: Nearly half of Gen Z still rely on family for rent or groceries — financial fragility is real

topics.topic: Bed rotting instead of facing finances
topics.opening_question: Did you avoid looking at your bank account or dealing with a financial thing today — and just lie around instead?
topics.resonance: 1 in 3 Gen Z bed rots specifically to cope with financial stress — Amerisleep 2025 study

topics.opening_question: Did student loans come to mind today and affect how you felt about things?
topics.resonance: $32,000 average debt for Gen Z students — a daily psychological weight

topics.opening_question: Did you have to say no to something social or enjoyable today because of money?
topics.resonance: 2 in 3 Americans skip weddings and dinners due to financial constraints — Gen Z hardest hit

topics.opening_question: Did the pressure to hustle on the side — beyond your main thing — come up today?
topics.resonance: Gen Z has the highest rate of side hustle adoption — and the highest burnout from it

topics.opening_question: Did a financial goal — saving up, moving out, paying something off — feel distant today?
topics.resonance: Gen Z is hitting traditional milestones later — and feeling the gap acutely

topics.opening_question: Did you do something today that was good for your finances — even something small?
topics.resonance: Important to capture small positive money moments to break the doom loop

topics.opening_question: Did rising prices hit you in a specific way today — groceries, rent, gas, anything?
topics.resonance: Inflation is the top source of financial anxiety across all generations — Gen Z worst affected

topics.opening_question: Did the uncertainty of what the next few years might look like feel heavy today?
topics.resonance: Gen Z grew up through pandemic, recession, climate anxiety — chronic future uncertainty

topics.opening_question: Did money come up with family today — either a tension, a favor, or a reality check?
topics.resonance: 80% of Americans avoid money conversations — Gen Z included despite wanting transparency

topics.opening_question: Did you see what someone your age is doing career-wise and feel something about where you are?
topics.resonance: LinkedIn is described by Gen Z as 'the most anxiety-inducing social media platform'

topics.opening_question: Did thoughts about the future of the planet affect how you felt about your own future today?
topics.resonance: Climate anxiety is uniquely significant for Gen Z — they're inheriting the problem

topics.opening_question: Is there something you're building toward — financially or career-wise — that gave you even a small sense of direction today?
topics.resonance: Anchoring to a goal — even vague — reduces financial anxiety meaningfully

modules.label: Body / Emotions
modules.tagline: How is your body and your inner world today?

topics.opening_question: Are you feeling wiped out today even though nothing extreme happened — just a deep, unexplained tired?
topics.resonance: Emotional exhaustion presenting as physical fatigue is extremely common in Gen Z

topics.opening_question: Has your mind been keeping you up at night — thoughts running even when your body wants to rest?
topics.resonance: 70% of Gen Z lose sleep to anxiety — the highest rate of any generation

topics.opening_question: Did anxiety show up today when you weren't expecting it — fast heartbeat, chest tight, that kind of thing?
topics.resonance: 50% of Gen Z report feeling anxious a lot of the day — intrusive physical anxiety is common

topics.opening_question: Did a wave of low mood hit today without a specific cause you could point to?
topics.resonance: 42% of Gen Z struggled with depression and hopelessness — often arriving without obvious triggers

topics.opening_question: Did thoughts about how you look or feel in your body come up today — positively or negatively?
topics.resonance: Physical standards obsession is one of 5 main Gen Z mental health drivers — Medium analysis

topics.opening_question: Did you spend time on your phone today that made you feel better — or actually worse after?
topics.resonance: Gen Z averages 9 hours of screen time — many recognize it harms them but continue

topics.topic: Something made me feel good in my body
topics.opening_question: Was there a moment today where your body felt okay — moved, rested, fed, or just comfortable?
topics.resonance: Noticing physical comfort anchors Gen Z away from chronic anxiety — important to capture

topics.opening_question: Did you cry today — or feel like you needed to but couldn't quite get there?
topics.resonance: Gen Z is the most open generation about emotional expression — crying is normalized

topics.opening_question: Did you spend part of today just in bed or on the couch, not really doing anything — and was that by choice?
topics.resonance: 37% of Gen Z bed rot regularly — it's both coping and avoidance

topics.opening_question: Did you spend time today just consuming content — shows, TikTok, YouTube — to kind of not feel something?
topics.resonance: Gen Z uses media consumption as emotional avoidance more than any generation

topics.topic: Physical symptom that might be stress
topics.opening_question: Has your body been giving you signals lately — headaches, tension, stomach stuff — that might be stress?
topics.resonance: Stress-related physical symptoms are common and under-discussed among Gen Z

topics.opening_question: Did you have a moment today where you just felt... off from yourself? Like you were going through the motions?
topics.resonance: Depersonalization and dissociation symptoms are rising in Gen Z — often unrecognized

topics.topic: Didn't eat well / forgot to eat
topics.opening_question: Did food and eating work for you today — or did it kind of slip through?
topics.resonance: Under-eating from stress or forgetting to eat is a common Gen Z self-neglect pattern

topics.opening_question: Was there a moment today where you felt genuinely calm — not numb, not distracted, but actually okay?
topics.resonance: Noticing calm moments is key for Gen Z who normalize constant low-grade anxiety

topics.topic: Therapy or mental health tool helped today
topics.opening_question: Did you use anything today — a therapy insight, breathing, journaling — that actually helped?
topics.resonance: Gen Z is the most therapy-engaged generation — reinforcing what works matters

topics.opening_question: Did your inner voice get pretty harsh on you today?
topics.resonance: Gen Z has high rates of negative self-talk — often starting from comparison culture

topics.opening_question: Did everything feel like too much at once today — like you couldn't figure out where to even start?
topics.resonance: Executive dysfunction from anxiety is highly relatable and discussed in Gen Z spaces

topics.topic: Something I did to take care of myself
topics.opening_question: Did you do one thing for yourself today — something small that was just for you?
topics.resonance: Self-care is a core Gen Z value — capturing it builds positive self-regard

topics.topic: Feeling like I'm running on empty
topics.opening_question: Does it feel like you've been running on fumes lately — giving out more than you're taking in?
topics.resonance: Emotional depletion without recovery is the definition of Gen Z burnout

topics.opening_question: Is there a feeling that's been with you today that you can't quite put a word to?
topics.resonance: Gen Z is emotionally expressive but sometimes hits the edge of their vocabulary — this prompt opens space
